'''Hal Lars''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], where he operated the equipment shop [[Hal's Parts Store]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Lars was an elderly man, and he relied on [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and cybernetic hearing to augment his senses. He had a good memory and possessed a detailed knowledge of the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that passed through the Wheel.
